name: Greater Animate Undead
description: (Tag:summon)Animate corpses into undead such as Dread Knights, Liches, Vampires, Wraiths, Soul Eaters, Bone Dragons, or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Elite Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 500 at once.
